source.boundary: The full run artifacts are local evidence. This checked-in summary is the public engineering-note artifact and does not make winner, leaderboard, paper-grade, resource-efficiency, or patch-quality claims.

appendixOnlyLanes.reason: bounded local indexing readiness failed earlier; not part of this corrected 20x1 headline table

methodology.notMeasured: patch correctness, developer productivity, provider-dollar spend, multi-repeat confidence intervals
methodology.scoring: official ContextBench evaluator on saved retrieval trajectories using per-task gold; scorer gold was not read during retrieval
methodology.measured: retrieval overlap, setup/index time, row wall time, process memory telemetry, GPU availability probe, failure rows
methodology.metricView: failure-inclusive means; judge_failed/no_context rows count as zero in the public summary
methodology.publicFrame: we benchmarked these tools on open-source repos

interpretation: jCodeMunch and codebase-context are close on file/span retrieval in this fixed adapter run; jCodeMunch has stronger symbol coverage but lower file precision.
codebase-context completed all 20 retrieval rows in this run but was expensive to index with local Transformers embeddings.
jCodeMunch is much cheaper to index in this adapter run, but its exact cold/warm install/cache boundary still needs care before cost claims.
context-mode is lightweight and low-cost, with lower recall ceiling in this run.
Repowise indexed and returned rows, but used the highest peak private memory, every index exited nonzero with a documented benign failure mode, and one row produced no extracted context.
raw-native is a deterministic lexical baseline here, not a free-form raw agent ceiling; it had low retrieval-overlap on these 20 tasks.

caveats.publicDocs: passed: README/docs/package-facing benchmark wording is aligned to the narrow 100-row retrieval-overlap engineering-note framing
caveats.overclaiming: passed: public wording keeps winner, leaderboard, paper-grade, resource-efficiency, patch-quality, and productivity claims blocked
caveats.patchQuality: blocked: retrieval-overlap only, no downstream patch/test success measured
caveats.costAccounting: partial_pass: setup/index/resource telemetry captured; provider-dollar costs remain none/unknown because no paid provider use was approved
caveats.repeatStability: blocked: 1 repeat per lane/task, no paper-grade stability or confidence claim
caveats.artifactCompleteness: passed: 100 rows have summary, trajectory, raw trace, setup, telemetry, and gold
caveats.failureInclusion: passed: Repowise judge_failed/no_context row is retained and zero-filled metric view exists

metaCost.note: Benchmark orchestration cost is authoring/evaluation overhead, not a lane score.
metaCost.latestKnownCodexGoalTokens: owner-reported 2.29B input and 7.48M output tokens before this corrected scoring pass; exact all-run total not independently audited here
